sharpened: Film the moment you first played "Tuesday Night" live — not the clean take, the one where your voice cracked on the second verse. Say out loud why you almost didn't play it that night, then let the crack stay in the clip instead of cutting around it.
why: "Post about the new song" is too broad to shoot. Anchoring it to one specific, imperfect moment gives you a real hook and an honest ending, instead of another polished song-announcement post.
